text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The United Nations Development Programme plans to invest $500,000 in the southern Cuando Cubango province in a number of projects to assist demobilised soldiers.
- U.S. Ambassador to Angola Donald Steinberg met on Monday with Angolan Prime Minister Franca van Dunem.
- U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan will meet members of the national assembly when he visits Angola on Saturday.
